NHAI Addresses Social Media Claims on Rajasthan Rumble Strips

The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) responded on August 3, 2026, to social media criticism regarding rumble strips on NH-25 in Rajasthan. NHAI stated that viral images showing faulty strips did not represent the actual condition, providing a comparative picture to illustrate the difference. Following online scrutiny, NHAI suspended a Project Director in connection with the controversy over reporting on the rumble strips.
